test_title: PYST 230: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 14th Nov, 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: ‘Pen’ is related to ‘Ink’ in the same way as ‘Needle’ is related to ‘_______’.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• ‘Pen’ is related to ‘Ink’ → Ink is required to use a pen. We can also say that pen and ink are complementary goods.

Similarly,

 
• ‘Needle’ is related to ‘_______’ → Needle is required to use a thread. Needle and thread are complementary goods.

Hence, '**Thread**' is the correct answer.
